title: A flower
done: You made a flower! Count the petals.

steps.say: Put a yellow square flat on the table. It is the middle of the flower.
Put a red triangle on top of the square.
Put a red triangle next to the square, on this side.
And one more red triangle on the other side.
Put a green square under the flower. That is the stem.
A small green triangle next to the stem makes a leaf.
